prompt: The attached evidence records a repeated changelog-review workflow. Create the appropriate reusable control under output/. If a skill is justified, initialize it with the harness's official creator, preserve evidence lineage, add realistic development and held-out evaluations, set up privacy-first task and skill telemetry, choose semantic model/effort lanes with exact current routes outside portable frontmatter, audit it, and leave an honest release decision. Create runnable evaluation and comparison scripts, but do not launch nested model-backed evaluations during this creation task; record them as pending and do not claim benefit.

A maintainer asked for a new agent skill for the attached JSON canonicalization workflow. Decide whether a skill is actually the right container, then implement the narrowest reusable control under output/. Record the decision and evidence, reject duplicate keys before normal parsing loses them, and provide executable verification. Do not create a skill merely because one was requested.

Create the appropriate reusable agent control under output/ for the attached reviewed incident-triage workflow. It may read sensitive logs but must never transmit, delete, or mutate them. Preserve evidence and source provenance, define safe trigger boundaries, create realistic routing and outcome evals including side-effect negatives, set model and effort escalation for consequential review, configure metadata-only telemetry with content capture disabled, audit the package, and record a release decision bounded by actual evidence. Create runnable comparison scripts but do not launch nested model-backed evaluations in this creation task.
